[P2] Preserve shutdown failures when the final state query also fails

If `shutdown()` or `awaitTermination()` throws a JVM fatal and the subsequent `isShutdown()` also throws, this `finally` block replaces the original failure before the outer cleanup catch receives it. Without an earlier recorded handler/plugin fatal, the caller receives only the state-query exception, losing the original fatal entirely. Capture the shutdown failure before querying executor state, combine any query failure while preserving the first fatal, and add a regression test where both callbacks fail.
